info.title: LED current limiter
info.question: How does resistance change LED current?
info.expected: Increasing the series resistance lowers current and the illustrative LED brightness.
info.try: Change R1 from 1 kΩ to 2 kΩ and compare signed current.
info.limitation: Generic red LED; brightness is illustrative and there is no thermal behavior or physical part rating.
